native_mechanisms: Walk both symbol-coil rows in lockstep on the diagonal and count one 'fire' at every position where the facing symbols match — the count of matches is the only thing kept.

Allow the boundary 'door' between the rows to break exactly once per crossing: at a mismatch, one row's coil crouches forward past the quarrel, holding a one-step offset to the end; a second break voids that crossing entirely.
Give every attempted crossing its own room holding its fire-pile, sink voided/twice-broken attempts into an unread underground tower, and return only the single highest pile.
core_technique: O(n) prefix-sum enumeration of the ungapped diagonal match count plus every single-shift (one-gap-at-a-mismatch) alignment in both directions, taking the maximum via a SUNK sentinel and converting match counts to +1/-1/-2 alignment score — not a DP table.
